description: Official Bloxchain deployments. The CreateX catalog addresses are identical on every supported network (same deployer, salt byte21=0x00, bytecodeHash none). Networks list which chains carry that catalog; they do not repeat the addresses. This file ships with @bloxchain/contracts and is mirrored in public documentation. It is NOT deployed-addresses.json (git-ignored deploy-script output for any chain, including lab).

declarationPolicy.whoDeclares: A network appears here only after a human release owner declares its CreateX catalog official; the release checklist records the declaration.
declarationPolicy.whatQualifies: Deployed from the CreateX same-address rail (SPEC-2026-0137), verified (explorer and/or Sourcify), and intended for outside integrators. Local, lab and throwaway deployments never qualify. Faucet-deferred testnets stay out until catalogued.
declarationPolicy.howToAdd: Deploy and verify the CreateX catalog on the new chain (addresses must match catalog.contracts). Then: node scripts/promote-official-addresses.cjs --network <name> --chain-id <id> --declare. The script refuses to write without --declare and refuses a network whose addresses differ from the shared catalog. Validate with: npm run validate:official-addresses
declarationPolicy.sharedCatalog: catalog.contracts is the Platform CreateX address book (BasicFactory → BasicAccount). Do not paste those six addresses under every network. Network rows point at the catalog id.
declarationPolicy.developerTools: Optional per-network developerTools overlay holds the Sepolia experiment (AccountBlox / CopyBlox): an open factory and a 1-second AccountBlox floor. The integrator mint is BasicFactory → BasicAccount.
declarationPolicy.pendingRows: A contract that is not yet declared is listed with "address": null and "status": "pending-declaration". Addresses are never guessed.

catalog.label: CreateX same-address catalog v1
catalog.notes: The integrator mint is BasicFactory → BasicAccount. Addresses are the same on every network listed under networks that references this catalog.

EngineBlox.notes: State machine library. Linked into BasicAccount at compile time; an account does not call it by address.

SecureOwnableDefinitions.notes: Passed as definitionAddress to the SDK's updateRecovery / updateTimeLock execution-parameter helpers.

RuntimeRBACDefinitions.notes: Passed as definitionAddress to roleConfigBatchExecutionParams and getRoleConfigActionSpecs.

GuardControllerDefinitions.notes: Passed as definitionAddress to guardConfigBatchExecutionParams and getGuardConfigActionSpecs.

BasicAccount.notes: Clone source for the official factory. Already initialized so the implementation cannot be claimed; Clones.copy runtime code, not storage. Do not operate this address as an account. Time-lock bounds: 1–90 days.

gas.notes: Typical gasUsed for cloneBloxDeterministic (salt 0, first free index) on CreateX-matched L2s and Ethereum is ~16.16M. Send with an explicit gas limit at the EIP-7825 per-tx cap (2^24) on capped networks; never rely on a bare estimate. Some L2s (e.g. Polygon PoS) measured ~17.88M — raise the send limit above the observed use on that chain.

BasicFactory.notes: cloneBlox (new address each call) and cloneBloxDeterministic (predictable address) deploy and initialize a BasicAccount. The caller must be initialOwner. Deterministic clones share an address across catalog networks only for the same minter, owner, index and salt.

sepolia.notes: CreateX baseline testnet. Integrator mint = BasicFactory → BasicAccount. Sepolia also lists the experimental AccountBlox / CopyBlox pair under developerTools.

AccountBlox.notes: Experimental template (contracts/examples), Sepolia only. Time-lock floor is 1 second. BasicAccount floor is 1 day. Linked libraries on this row are the historical Sepolia foundation addresses, not the CreateX catalog.

gas.notes: Observed gasUsed for cloneBlox against AccountBlox on Sepolia. Public networks cap a single transaction at 2^24 = 16,777,216 (EIP-7825).

CopyBlox.notes: Experimental factory (contracts/examples), Sepolia only. Open factory: can clone any standard IBaseStateMachine blox, including AccountBlox. BasicFactory is pinned to BasicAccount. Predates the owner-indexed clone list; enumerate from BloxCloned logs. Wire via @bloxchain/contracts artifacts + viem. Not exported from @bloxchain/sdk.

arc-testnet.notes: CreateX same-address catalog. Native gas is USDC.

polygon.notes: CreateX same-address catalog. DET mint measured ~17.88M gasUsed — raise send gas above the catalog default when needed.

BasicFactory.notes: Polygon PoS DET mint measured ~17.88M; send above the EIP-7825 L1 catalog default (2^24).

arc.notes: CreateX same-address catalog. Native gas is USDC.
